en-US.description: Boost meeting efficiency for any conference space with Rooms - a wireless and scalable solution for your video conferencing needs.
en-US.longDescription: Transform your meeting spaces into dynamically enabled video conferencing destinations. Using existing off-the-shelf equipment, you can easily set up, hold, and manage video conferences with the highest quality “in-room” experience. Walk into any room and easily start and control a video meeting with one touch. Share presentations, documents, and other content wirelessly from your laptop. Seamlessly reserve rooms from Microsoft and Google calendar integrations.
en-US.name: RingCentral Rooms

zh-CN.description: 为任何会议空间提升会议效率——Rooms 为您提供无线、可扩展的视频会议解决方案。
zh-CN.longDescription: 将您的会议空间转变为动态启用的视频会议场所。利用现有的现成设备，您可轻松设置、召开和管理视频会议，享受最高品质的“室内”体验。走进任意房间，一键即可轻松启动和控制视频会议。从笔记本电脑无线共享演示文稿、文档及其他内容。通过微软和谷歌日历集成，无缝预约会议室。
